Confirm that `1772071015_C02` appears in `results/zeisel/tables/cell-qc.tsv`, then run:

```bash
Rscript scripts/R/verify_cell.R zeisel 1772071015_C02
```

| Quantity | Verified value |

## Recalculate from the source matrix

The two worked calculations are:

\[
100\times\frac{774}{22{,}354}=3.462468\%\quad\text{(rounded)},
\]

\[
\log\left(1+10{,}000\frac{3}{22{,}354}\right)=0.8510231\quad\text{(rounded)}.
\]

This is **R code**, to run in an R console opened from the main project folder:

```r
library(Matrix)
counts <- readRDS("data/zeisel/counts.rds")
genes <- read.delim("data/zeisel/gene-metadata.tsv")
x <- as.numeric(counts[, "1772071015_C02"])
names(x) <- rownames(counts)
mito <- genes$is_mito[match(names(x), genes$gene_id)]
sum(x)
sum(x > 0)
sum(x[mito])
100 * sum(x[mito]) / sum(x)
x["Tshz1"]
log1p(10000 * x["Tshz1"] / sum(x))
y <- readRDS("results/zeisel/normalized.rds")
y["Tshz1", "1772071015_C02"]
```

Exit R with `q(save = "no")` before using terminal commands again. Compare these calculations with the saved QC row and transformed value.

## Explain what passed

The independent script does not call the workflow's QC functions. It checks raw-input file consistency, per-cell arithmetic, retention against saved cutoffs and one positive gene's transformed value for retained cells. It does not validate donor mapping or the biological meaning of PCA.

All 400 cells pass the configured rules in this run, so there is no excluded-cell case to verify here. Repeat with a second exact cell ID from the saved table; do not invent a failure to mirror synthetic practice.
